title: A fair measure reveals important meaning

captions.energy: Matching an assessment to actual material

meaning: Comparing experience as a whole can bring an important realisation when assessment becomes proportionate to what you actually experienced.
text: Important meaning can emerge through honestly comparing different parts of experience. The World in the physical position of Ajna suggests connecting observations within a whole picture. Justice in energy supports assessment proportionate to actual material. Judgement in emotions experiences significant fresh understanding. Discovery has concrete foundations to examine together.

Suppose you choose photographs for an account of a trip and initially favour only pictures where both people smile. Comparing memories restores a serious-looking image taken during an absorbing conversation. **A fair measure can reveal meaning a familiar assessment overlooked.** Facial expression becomes distinguishable from a moment’s significance. This can resonate more strongly than the photograph’s selection itself. The shared picture regains an episode previously excluded. You can understand more accurately what expresses experience while cheerful images keep their pleasure and another impression remains visible without having to look identical.

The risk is seeking concealed depth in every previously unappealing picture after a powerful discovery. Another assessment becomes too broad. Seeking fair proportion preserves the realisation’s subject. One image revealed an earlier conclusion’s boundary while others still need consideration of their own. A shared view changes substantially when an important discovery keeps its scale and leaves actual experience free to include simple pleasure without further explanation.
